title: SmartAgri FTP UGM Researcher Serves as Speaker at Polbangtan Bogor National Seminar on Smart Farming for Sustainable Food Self-Sufficiency

body:
**Yogyakarta, June 2026** – **Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, S.T.P., M.Sc., Ph.D., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng.**, a lecturer at the Faculty of Agricultural Technology, Universitas Gadjah Mada and member of the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri), will serve as a speaker at the **8th Dies Natalis National Seminar of Politeknik Pembangunan Pertanian (Polbangtan) Bogor** with the theme _"Smart Farming as a Strategy for Sustainable Food Self-Sufficiency"_.

The event organized by Polbangtan Bogor will be held online on **June 24, 2026** via Zoom Meeting platform and YouTube live streaming. The seminar will bring together academics, practitioners, and industry stakeholders who are committed to the transformation of agriculture toward more efficient, productive, and sustainable production systems.

On this occasion, Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho will present material on **"Implementation of Smart Farming to Increase Agricultural Production Efficiency Supporting Sustainable Food Self-Sufficiency."** This topic is highly relevant in addressing the challenges of modern agriculture, such as limited resources, climate change, increasing food demand, and the need for production efficiency.

Smart farming is a technology-based agricultural approach that leverages sensors, Internet of Things (IoT), artificial intelligence, data analytics, and automation systems to support more precise decision-making. The implementation of these technologies is expected to increase productivity, improve the efficiency of agricultural input use, and promote the sustainability of the national food production system.

In addition to Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho, the seminar will also feature **Prof. Dr. Sofyan Sjaf, S.Pt., M.Si.** (Dean of the Faculty of Human Ecology, IPB University) and **drh. Deddy Fachruddin Kurniawan, M.Vet.** (Founder and CEO of Dairy Pro Indonesia and MOOSA Genetics) as keynote speakers.

Through this activity, it is hoped that stronger collaboration will be built among universities, government, industry, and communities in developing agricultural technology innovations that can support the realization of sustainable food self-sufficiency in Indonesia.

The seminar is open to academics, researchers, students, practitioners, extension officers, and the general public who have an interest in the development of agricultural technology and smart farming innovation.

**Event Information**

-   Day/Date: Wednesday, June 24, 2026
-   Time: 08:00 WIB – end of event
-   Media: Zoom Meeting & YouTube Live
-   Registration: bit.ly/SemnasPolbangtanBogor2026

original.body:
**Yogyakarta, Juni 2026** – Dosen Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian Universitas Gadjah Mada sekaligus anggota Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri), **Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, S.T.P., M.Sc., Ph.D., IPU., ASEAN Eng., APEC Eng.**, akan menjadi narasumber pada **Seminar Nasional Dies Natalis ke-8 Politeknik Pembangunan Pertanian (Polbangtan) Bogor** yang mengangkat tema _“Smart Farming sebagai Strategi Swasembada Pangan Berkelanjutan”_.

Kegiatan yang diselenggarakan oleh Polbangtan Bogor ini akan berlangsung secara daring pada **24 Juni 2026** melalui platform Zoom Meeting dan siaran langsung YouTube. Seminar menghadirkan akademisi, praktisi, serta pelaku industri yang memiliki perhatian terhadap transformasi pertanian menuju sistem produksi yang lebih efisien, produktif, dan berkelanjutan.

Pada kesempatan tersebut, Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho akan menyampaikan materi mengenai **“Penerapan Smart Farming untuk Peningkatan Efisiensi Produksi Pertanian Mendukung Swasembada Pangan Berkelanjutan.”** Topik ini menjadi sangat relevan dalam menghadapi tantangan sektor pertanian modern, seperti keterbatasan sumber daya, perubahan iklim, peningkatan kebutuhan pangan, serta tuntutan efisiensi produksi.

Smart farming merupakan pendekatan pertanian berbasis teknologi yang memanfaatkan sensor, Internet of Things (IoT), kecerdasan buatan (Artificial Intelligence), analisis data, serta sistem otomasi untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan yang lebih presisi. Implementasi teknologi tersebut diharapkan mampu meningkatkan produktivitas, efisiensi penggunaan input pertanian, serta keberlanjutan sistem produksi pangan nasional.

Selain Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho, seminar ini juga menghadirkan **Prof. Dr. Sofyan Sjaf, S.Pt., M.Si.** (Dekan Fakultas Ekologi Manusia IPB University) dan **drh. Deddy Fachruddin Kurniawan, M.Vet.** (Founder dan CEO Dairy Pro Indonesia serta MOOSA Genetics) sebagai pembicara utama.

Melalui kegiatan ini, diharapkan terbangun kolaborasi yang lebih kuat antara perguruan tinggi, pemerintah, industri, dan masyarakat dalam mengembangkan inovasi teknologi pertanian yang mampu mendukung terwujudnya swasembada pangan yang berkelanjutan di Indonesia.

Seminar terbuka bagi akademisi, peneliti, mahasiswa, praktisi, penyuluh, serta masyarakat umum yang memiliki minat pada pengembangan teknologi pertanian dan inovasi smart farming.

**Informasi Kegiatan**

-   Hari/Tanggal: Rabu, 24 Juni 2026
-   Waktu: 08.00 WIB – selesai
-   Media: Zoom Meeting & YouTube Live
-   Pendaftaran: bit.ly/SemnasPolbangtanBogor2026
